title: Representation of the People Second Amendment Ordinance 1996

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Second Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1997
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 4th February, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 4‑2‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Representation of the People (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
